> **This repository is a generated mirror and does not accept pull requests.**
>
> Everything outside `.github/` is emitted by the SDK generator in
> [Infrawrench/Infrawrench](https://github.com/Infrawrench/Infrawrench) and is

> overwritten by the next publish.
>
> Change the generator instead — `app/packages/web/scripts/sdk/targets/` — or
